response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - st.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE s.share > st.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those that have at least one telescope in the telescopes table, since the request says to count telescopes at each observatory from that table. The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-observatory shares over those observatories, and 'above average' means strictly greater than that mean.

alternatives.interpretation: 'All observatories' means every row in the observatories table, so observatories with zero telescopes get a count of 0 and a share of 0 and are included in the average share. Only observatories above that average are then summarized.
alternatives.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - st.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE s.share > st.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above;
